thread:
oncall-bot: Pager: HIGH — Customer private connectivity degraded for tenant `acme-corp` in us-west-2 (PrivateLink endpoints intermittently unreachable) :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Alert details: 3+ failures in healthcheck stream to pl-ep-54 in us-west-2b, BGP adj flaps observed between our Transit GW and aws-vpn-12. Incident ID: INC-2026-0419-01

matt: Acked. I'm on call. Pulling logs and BGP state now.

matt: Quick snapshot — BGP shows rapid prefix withdraws for 10.200.0.0/16 from aws-vpn-12, peer ASN 64512. See `show bgp summary` output: 
```
BGP neighbor 10.0.1.1     ASN 64512  UP  00:00:12  prefixes 42  200K msgs
BGP neighbor 10.0.1.1     ASN 64512  DOWN  00:00:03  prefixes 0  20K msgs
... flapping every ~10-40s
```

sara: I'm seeing the same from our end — PrivateLink healthchecks failing then healthy. Affected services: embeddings ingestion (writes) for acme-corp, ~30% of requests get TCP RST.

raj: Assigning network infra. @kevin_pls can you join? This smells like an upstream peering jitter or BFD weirdness.

kevin: On it. Pulled provider telemetry — AWS reports transient route churn in us-west-2b edge. Provider message: "we are investigating an edge networking maintenance causing BGP flaps for a subset of VPN endpoints". Created AWS support case 789012345.

matt: Customer impact — CS says acme-corp experiencing write failures to private endpoints since ~12:22 PDT. I'll draft a short customer-facing note. @cs-rep please hold until I confirm mitigation.

cs-rep: Copy. Keep it concise: timeframe, affected endpoints, current mitigation, recommended workaround.

matt: Triage actions so far:
- Identified BGP flap on aws-vpn-12 -> ASN 64512 between our TransitGW and provider.
- Scaled up healthcheck retries + extended TCP timeout on PL endpoints to reduce false positives.
- Opened AWS ticket and engaged NOC.
- Preparing traffic shift to us-west-2a endpoint pair for acme-corp.

sara: How safe is shifting traffic? We have spare capacity in us-west-2a but need to ensure KV cache warmup doesn't regress latency.

matt: Plan A (short): fail over acme's PrivateLink DNS to us-west-2a pair via override in our routing plane for their tenant only. This avoids changing customer DNS but rewrites next-hop at our edge. Will only affect acme-corp.

matt: Plan B (if AWS can't stabilize): temporarily advertise an alternative /16 via a stable path and blackhole the flapping peer. Will coordinate with infra and provider.

kevin: Meanwhile I'm asking AWS for BFD/BGP timer history and whether maintenance was scheduled. Also checking for interface error counters on the transit attachment.

kevin: Found interface errors on transit-attach-23 correlated with flap windows: 
```
Interface eth3: input errors 1245, CRC 16
Last flap 2026-04-19T19:24:12Z
```

raj: That's consistent with a hardware issue. If AWS confirms, we'd prefer they repair, but we need short-term mitigation.

matt: I'm going to perform the tenant-level override to shift acme traffic to us-west-2a. Executing change in 2 mins unless objections. This will be visible in routing logs.

sara: thumbs up from me. Monitor for cache-miss surge. I'll watch telemetry dashboards.

matt: Executing override now: `routedb apply --tenant acme-corp --override next_hop=us-west-2a-pl`

oncall-bot: Change applied by matt at 19:31:05 PDT. Propagation to edge nodes in ~30s.

sara: Seeing decrease in healthcheck failures immediately. Error rate for embeddings ingestion down from 28% -> 4% over last 90s.

cs-rep: Sent customer note (status update): "We've detected transient network instability affecting private connectivity in us-west-2b. We've rerouted your traffic to an alternate endpoint in us-west-2a to restore service while we work with the cloud provider. Some requests during the incident window may have failed; we're tracking and can help with retries if needed."

kevin: AWS replied — unplanned hardware replacement in us-west-2b edge causing flaps. ETA for stabilization ~2 hours. They've recommended our current failover and will provide root-cause followup. Case 789012345 updated.

matt: Good. I'm going to record mitigation steps for postmortem. Current state: customer traffic on us-west-2a, no active flaps observed from our TransitGW, monitoring for 30m.

raj: Please prepare a short handoff for the next on-call with actions and watchlist items.

matt: Handoff summary (to leave in thread):
- Problem: BGP adj flapping with provider VPN attachment (aws-vpn-12) causing PrivateLink healthcheck failures for acme-corp in us-west-2b.
- Impact: Intermittent failures (TCP RST) affecting write path; estimated 12:22–19:31 PDT with reduced error rates after failover.
- Mitigation performed: tenant-level next_hop override to us-west-2a (routedb change) at 19:31:05 PDT. Healthchecks recovered.
- Ongoing: AWS performing hardware replacement; monitoring for route stability.
- Next steps for followup on-call: watch for route withdraws, monitor cache warmup latency, validate embedding ingestion SLOs for acme-corp, coordinate with CS for any customer-requested data replay.

matt: Leaving now for 30m break; tagging @raj as primary. @raj please take over and escalate if AWS indicates broader impact.

raj: Acked. Taking over. I'll keep an eye on the AWS case and run periodic `show bgp` checks every 5m.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: matt -> raj at 19:36:10 PDT. Pager muted for matt.

kevin: AWS updated — hardware replacement complete in us-west-2b. They recommend removing the override after 15m of stable routes.

raj: Noted. We'll wait 15m then test re-propagation to us-west-2b for acme. Plan is: 
1) remove tenant override `routedb revert --tenant acme-corp --override next_hop`
2) monitor healthchecks for 10m; if flaps reappear, revert and open escalation.

sara: Also let's capture a packet sample from the edge for the postmortem — `tcpdump` on host edge-proxy-07 filtered to acme-corp IPs for 5m. I'll schedule that.

cs-rep: Customer replied: "Thanks for the fast response. Please confirm when everything is back to normal so we can close our internal incident."

raj: Will do. I'll post final update after we re-enable and observe 15m stable.
